topic: Enforceability and Material Defects in PEAKS Loan Documents
supporting_evidence: The witness repeatedly indicates an inability to opine on the enforceability of the PEAKS loans beyond their origination, stating that if a loan never existed it was unenforceable from the outset and that there is no record to assess post‑origination events. The attorney probes whether the loans became unenforceable at any later point, whether the lack of required disclosures rendered them void ab initio, and whether any subsequent actions (e.g., Vervent refusing to service) would affect enforceability. The witness consistently declines to speculate, citing the scope of the report and lack of evidentiary basis. The line of questioning culminates with an inquiry into whether the witness observed any servicing deficiencies in the investigations and settlements related to the PEAKS program, tying the enforceability discussion to potential material defects in loan documentation and servicing practices.

anchors.start_quote: And I believe I asked you before about whether there was some time when, in your opinion, the PEAKS loans became unenforceable, and I believe you responded that you could not provide an opinion on that; is that correct?
anchors.end_quote: ...whether you noticed that anybody had any issues with the way that Vervent did the servicing on the loans.
